verdict.what_is_wrong: A newly appearing stress-ng-cpu workload in container pid_ns 4026533601 consumed about two CPU cores and coincided with increased scheduling waits in sampled workloads; those waits diminished after it exited. This supports CPU competition from a co-tenant, while the later synchronized event-rate rise around 13:50:20 is recovery after the workload stopped, not the incident onset.
